extracted.intended_audience: general newspaper readers; veterans eligible for GI Bill benefits
extracted.subtask_description: A collection of short Associated Press news briefs covering domestic and international items (Veterans Administration GI Bill rule changes, UN/foreign affairs, local incidents, displaced persons, etc.). Primarily for general-public news consumption.

rubrics_metrics.name: Advisement and guidance requirement for change of field
rubrics_metrics.description: From Nov. 1 on a veteran who has completed or discontinued a GI Bill course, and who wants to take another course in a different field, must undergo 'advisement and guidance.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: These new procedures are made necessary by passage of Public Law 266 by the 81st Congress.

rubrics_metrics.name: Certificate application must specify course and school
rubrics_metrics.description: A veteran applying for a certificate of eligibility for GI Bill training must specify the name of the course and school.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The agency said the new type of eligibility certificate, to be issued starting Nov. 1, is good only for the course and school specified.

rubrics_metrics.name: Ban on avocational and recreational courses
rubrics_metrics.description: Public Law 266 bans avocational and recreational courses.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: As a result, VA procedures prohibit enrollment of veterans in courses that are avocational/recreational in nature.

rubrics_metrics.name: Minimum-school-existence requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: VA is prohibited from permitting veterans to enroll in schools which have not been in existence at least one year prior to enrollment.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This is a statutory restriction under the referenced public law and affects eligibility for GI Bill training at newly established schools.

rubrics_metrics.name: Exception for additional training in same general field
rubrics_metrics.description: The veteran who wants an additional course of training in the same general field as his original educational or job objective may enroll without special advisement and guidance.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This permits continuity of training within the same general field without the new advisement step required for field changes.

rubrics_metrics.name: New eligibility certificate limited to specified course and school
rubrics_metrics.description: The new type of eligibility certificate, to be issued starting Nov. 1, is good only for the course and school specified.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Certificates issued before Nov. 1 will be honored after that date even though they do not list the course and school, provided the veteran is not changing into a new field of study or to a new school.

rubrics_metrics.name: Duty to verify school status and course-field classification
rubrics_metrics.description: VA urged veterans with unused certificates to make certain that the school in which they wish to enroll is permitted by law to offer GI Bill training.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: They can check the status of a school—and find out whether a new course is in the same or a different general field—by writing to or calling a VA office.
